title: Book, change or cancel a COVID-19 vaccination appointment
description: Book, change or cancel a COVID-19 vaccination appointment online.
body:
Use this service to: - check if you need an appointment - book an appointment - check your existing appointment details - change your appointment - cancel your appointment You can use this service if you are registered with a GP surgery in England. You can find UK wide vaccination services in Wales , Northern Ireland and Scotland . Find out how to register with a GP surgery if you're not registered.

Important: Booking service is now closed

You cannot book a COVID-19 vaccination using this service or by calling 119. COVID-19 vaccinations will be available again in autumn 2026.
